top_choice_rationale: P001 gives the cleanest scientific case: general, ligand-controlled palladium-catalysed C-N cross-coupling, with a mechanism (oxidative addition, amine binding, reductive elimination) confirmed over three decades, a clean two-name allocation to Buchwald and Hartwig, and a citation worded around the general catalytic method so that Kosugi's narrower tin-amide precursor is not misrepresented. P002 adds base editing with Liu alone, which leaves the Komor/Gaudelli and Target-AID attribution unresolved; P003 rests on a contested physiological scope and a three-name cap that excludes Pappu and Mittag; no award is the weakest outcome given a mature, well-attributed candidate exists.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; Xiaodong Zou is a Stockholm University colleague, but no connection to Buchwald, Hartwig, Kosugi, Liu, Hyman, Brangwynne or Rosen
